feature: Descriptive post-selection journey and recorded closures

authenticated_browser_rehearsal.note: The first local preview encountered an older incomplete direct-DB test application in another test tenant. The browser rehearsal used a fresh controlled tenant without deleting old fixtures or changing product code. Startup delays were resolved by starting the saved local database; no deployment failure is inferred.

Incomplete history does not establish event timing or a cause for missing progress.
